title: FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD
tagline: FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD is a new way for Miners to obtain green powered liquidity
description: The FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  has been built to leverage the FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  and to also leverage Green initiatives in the Filecoin Ecosystem. The  purpose of the FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  is to create a lending market for Miners that leverages the Green Audits that Miners can undergo as part of Filecoin Green. The  FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  will allow investors to deposit funds in exchange for Green Bonds. Miners will be able to borrow from the FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  using a combination of their Deals and their Green Credentials which allow them access to better rates.
how_its_made: The FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  is built on Filecoin Testnet Wallaby and specifically uses the Zondax Miner and Market API's to validate miner deals as part of the collateral creation process. The FEVM GREEN BIG BOARD  hosts the funds committed against Green Bonds and disburses these to requesting miners. Miners have to physically assign their deals to their issued loan contracts before they can draw down on the loans and this is validated using the Zondax APIs with checks as to beneficiary assignment.
